title: Fix semantic release authentication
description: The main-branch semantic release must authenticate with an existing repository secret so tested runtime API changes can be versioned and published. Acceptance: the release workflow passes a nonempty token to the reusable release job, all quality checks pass, and a new package version is published from main.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Live diagnosis: main release run 30298522347 failed before checkout because the workflow passed nonexistent repository secret ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN. The repository exposes GH_TOKEN and PYPI_TOKEN. Implementing the minimal secret-name correction, then validating workflow syntax and hosted checks.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the minimal correction from ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN to the existing GH_TOKEN repository secret. Verified the workflow parses as YAML and the diff is clean. Hosted release execution after merge will provide the end-to-end publication proof.
